name: One With The Cosmos
body:
School divination; Level cleric/oracle 9, druid/shaman 9, sorcerer/wizard 9, witch 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a crow’s egg)

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hr./level

DESCRIPTION

Upon casting this spell, you enter a state where the cosmos holds few mysteries, and this knowledge guides your actions in miraculous ways. You gain the effects of true seeing and freedom of movement, you cannot age, and you are unaffected by magical effects that can age you.

You do not need to eat, sleep, or breathe.

Furthermore, you are immune to compulsions, charms, daze, stun, fear effects, and sleep effects.

You cannot be confused, fatigued, or exhausted.

Furthermore, you gain a +10 insight bonus to all Knowledge skill checks, and you treat all Knowledge skill checks as if you were trained.
